name: Korean
modelReview: artifacts written 2026-11-13 by Claude Fable 5.2 from usage notes written in Korean with no knowledge of cron: answers, lexicon and hand-written paradigm rows, read that day twice against their patterns and four times by blind fluency readers, with five author passes; parked. 2026-11-19, by Claude Fable 5.2: revised for the rewritten CLAUDE.md, the core's calendar facts and the last reads' open findings. Bare rhythms from the first hour («2시간마다», «6시간마다»); hours at a step over a finer rhythm as a burst («2시간마다 1시간 동안 15분 간격으로») with no bracket of sample times; no count-and-bracket for seconds; exceptions only of listed values; a step of days from its start («매월 1일부터 3일마다»); the date itself where a count from the month's end comes to one day; «윤년마다»; both-must-match days («매월 홀수일 중 월요일인 날»). Every changed row was worked against its pattern by the author. That pass was read the same day by a blind judge briefed only in Korean (84 sentences, every reading of each) and by a schedule reader (all 696 rows against their patterns): no wrong time, and second readings in the burst («1시간 동안 15분 간격으로»: the end of the length counted as a firing), in «1일부터 5일 간격으로», in a trailing «부터», a bare stray minute, «해당 연도» and a union with an exception. Second pass, same day: no length is said anywhere; hours at a step are a frame of whole hours («0시대부터 오후 10시대까지 2시간 간격으로 각각 15분마다») and minutes a frame for seconds («…15분 간격으로 각각 0·30초»); «1일부터 시작해 5일 간격으로»; «이들 해에는»; four hours are a rhythm whatever the minute. A second blind judge read that pass's 62 sentences: three second readings (a stray «그리고 매시 45분» leaving its frame; «(매시 29분 제외)» under seconds; the union with a bracketed exception), and the frame of whole hours read with one meaning but not grasped. Third pass, same day, the two larger calls being the orchestrator's (Claude Fable 5.2): up to six stepped hours are named, every second hour is «짝수 시» or «홀수 시» (attested in descriptive prose on three wiki pages seen through search summaries, in no official timetable), the frame stays only past six hours at another step; a whole minute or hour filled at its finest rhythm is «1분간 1초마다», «한 시간 내내 1분마다»; «그리고 45분에도»; «15일을 뺀 홀수일» in a union. A third blind judge read that pass's 67 sentences and found most natural with one reading, «짝수 시» included (a few readers may hesitate over whether 0시 is even). Fourth pass, same day: the frame of hours, read as one stretch, is gone and hours are always named, compactly («오전 1·4·7·10시대, 오후 1·4·7·10시대에»); every union is «매주 …, 그리고 매월 …에도, …» and its date arm never carries an exception («1~14·16~31일의 홀수일»); a tiling rhythm is bare everywhere; «5일마다» again; the time part of the answers rewritten as one decision procedure for the builder. The renderer was then built from the artifacts by an agent that saw no other renderer and no held-out row (153 of 153 held-out rows on the first judged run), and audited the same day by a second agent (Claude Fable 5.2): the answers against the code, about 2,700 descriptions read beside each pattern's fire times from the reading oracle, and the rows. No description named a time that does not fire; a step of days under named months named an end some of them lack (now «…1일부터 26일까지 5일마다(1월에는 31일에도)»); one hard-case row was wrong (five uneven times are a list); two brackets in a row, a calendar phrase that answered to the time («이들 해 내내»), an ungrammatical condition on a step of days, seconds under minutes less one, rhythms found by chance in scattered values, and a count from the month's end with February were repaired test-first, and the builder's fourteen silent choices were written into the answers with rows. The forms this audit introduced have had no blind fluency read; «짝수 시» and «홀수 시» still await a native reviewer
